\subsection{Preimage frames for arbitrary binary subspaces}
This frame construction is due to icekylinx with OpenAI GPT-6 Astra assistance;
the present exposition and integration use Codex.
Let $H=\mathbb F_2^h$ with the standard dot product. In the binary
symplectic space $H\oplus H$ put
\[
 L_0=\{(0,z)\},\qquad
 F=\begin{pmatrix}I&I\\0&I\end{pmatrix},\qquad
 L_F=FL_0=\{(z,z)\}.
\]
We also write $F$ for the exact Gaussian-dyadic operator $C^{\otimes h}$.
Its exact square is a Pauli translation; only its binary symplectic square
is the identity. For an exact Clifford operator $T$ the frame label is
$L(T)=T^{-1}L_0$. The physical transition from $T$ to $S$ is $ST^{-1}$,
and its Fourier rank is
$d(L(S),L(T))$, where $d(L,L')=h-\dim(L\cap L')$.
This follows by transporting the intersection by $S$: the intersection
with $L_0$ computes the kernel dimension of the $B$ block of $ST^{-1}$.

\begin{lemma}
For every subspace $U\subseteq H$, including degenerate subspaces,
\[
 L_U=\{(u,u+v):u\in U,\ v\in U^\perp\}
\]
is Lagrangian, and
\[
 d(L_U,L_V)=\dim U+\dim V-2\dim(U\cap V),\qquad
 FL_U=L_{U^\perp}.
\]
\end{lemma}
\begin{proof}
The displayed parametrization is injective and has dimension $h$.
Its symplectic pairing is $u\cdot v'+v\cdot u'=0$.
In an intersection, $u$ belongs to $U\cap V$ and $v$ to
$(U+V)^\perp$, giving the asserted dimension and distance.
Finally $F(u,u+v)=(v,u+v)$ proves the complement identity.
\end{proof}

\subsection{Exact representatives and nested children}
Choose a deterministic invertible binary matrix $G$ carrying the first
$r=\dim U$ coordinate space $E_r$ to $U$, and set
\[
 K_G=\begin{pmatrix}G&0\\G+G^{-T}&G^{-T}\end{pmatrix},\qquad
 T_U=K_G T_{E_r}K_G^{-1}.
\]
Here $T_{E_r}$ is the exact coordinate $C$ operator, and the $K_G$ are
exact Gaussian-dyadic Clifford lifts. The matrix $K_G$ is symplectic
because $G^TG+I$ is symmetric. It fixes both $L_0,L_F$ and maps $L_V$
to $L_{GV}$. Thus both $K_G$ and $FK_GF^{-1}$ have Fourier rank zero;
their lifts are fixed binary address permutations with unit quadratic
phases. In particular,
\[
 L(T_U)=L_U,\quad \operatorname{rank}B(T_U)=r,\quad
 \operatorname{rank}B(FT_UF^{-1})=r,\quad T_U^2\text{ is Pauli}.
\]
Set $V_U=GE_r^\perp$, a direct complement of $U$. The binary action gives
$T_U^{-1}L_F=L_{V_U}$ and hence
$\operatorname{rank}B(FT_U^{-1})=h-r$.
No assertion $V_U=U^\perp$ is needed.
For the norm-one source lines and their orthogonal target hyperplanes,
retain the inherited exact representatives; set $T_0=I,T_H=F$.
At every common scalar gate use one identical exact representative on all
incident registers. If separately transported representatives have the
same preimage, their physical ratio has rank zero and is implemented as
an actual left adapter before the gate.

For $U\subseteq V$, the exact transition $T_VT_U^{-1}$ has rank
$\dim V-\dim U$. Clifford elimination expresses it as two rank-zero
adapters surrounding that many coordinate Fourier factors. These factors
are a single $C^{\otimes r}$ child: the scaled Hadamard satisfies
\[
 \frac{1+i}{2}\begin{pmatrix}1&1\\1&-1\end{pmatrix}
   =SCS,\qquad S=\operatorname{diag}(1,i).
\]
Thus no new irrational field is introduced. All adapters are charged
finite movement and scalar operations. Exact transitions telescope;
commutativity between distinct $T_U$ is unnecessary.

\subsection{Dirty tails and reverse/complement words}
A dirty role entering with gauge $T_\sigma$ and whose last active frame
is $T_U$, with $\sigma\subseteq U$, is assigned terminal gauge
$FT_\sigma$. Its logical value is restored by the complete transparent
scalar word, so its physical action is exactly $F$. The tail is
$FT_\sigma T_U^{-1}$. Its rank is
\[
 d(L_U,L_{V_\sigma})=h-\dim U+\dim\sigma.
\]
Indeed $H=\sigma\oplus V_\sigma$ and $U\supseteq\sigma$ imply
$\dim(U\cap V_\sigma)=\dim U-\dim\sigma$.
An inactive exterior adds $m-h$, giving $m-\dim U+\dim\sigma$.

For the complete time-reversed word use
\[
 D_U=T_UF^{-1},\qquad L(D_U)=L_{U^\perp},\qquad
 D_UD_V^{-1}=T_UT_V^{-1}.
\]
The last equality is exact, so reversal preserves every inverse transition
rank. Reverse the scalar signs and the whole transparent word, including
old-value corrections and final cleanup. The endpoints $D_0=F^{-1}$
and $F$ differ by a Pauli, and the inherited norm-one endpoints are
reconciled by actual rank-zero adapters. Neither equality of binary
matrices nor equality of frame cosets substitutes for these operators.
